scripts.build:css: npm run css:lint && npm run css:scss && npm run css:autoprefixer
scripts.deploy:check:syncroot: sh -c 'v=$(git config --get git-ftp.syncroot || true); [ "$v" = "dist/" ] || { echo "Expected git-ftp.syncroot=dist/ but got ${v:-<empty>}"; exit 1; }'
scripts.deploy:check:clean: sh -c 'git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet || { echo "Commit or stash changes before deploy."; exit 1; }'
scripts.deploy:dry-run: npm run build && npm run deploy:check:syncroot && npm run deploy:check:clean && git ftp push --dry-run --verbose
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy:check:syncroot && npm run deploy:check:clean && git ftp push
scripts.deploy:package: npm run build && rm -f deploy/chasingpoppies-dist.zip && mkdir -p deploy && cd dist && zip -r ../deploy/chasingpoppies-dist.zip .
